question: How much higher the average intrinsic value is for trades using the feeling-lucky strategy compared to those using the momentum strategy under long-side trades?

  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN StrikePrice - LastPx END) AS feeling_lucky_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN StrikePrice - LastPx END) AS momentum_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN StrikePrice - LastPx END) - 
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN StrikePrice - LastPx END) AS difference
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`,
UNNEST(Sides) s
WHERE s.Side = 'LONG'
